slides.title: Three kinds of tests
slides.html:
Testing

Three kinds of tests

Unit

One function, no database or network. Fast.

slugify(), paging()

Integration

Real requests through Express to a test DB.

POST /api/posts → 201

End-to-end

The whole app in a browser, like a user.

Playwright, Cypress

slides.title: Jest basics
slides.html:
Jest

Jest basics

  • describe groups tests
  • test (or it) is one case
  • expect + matchers check results
  • Run with npm test

tests/slugify.test.js

import { slugify } from "../src/utils/slugify.js";
 
describe("slugify", () => {
  test("lowercases and joins words with dashes", () => {
    expect(slugify("Hello World")).toBe("hello-world");
  });
 
  test("removes symbols", () => {
    expect(slugify("Node.js & Express!")).toBe("node-js-express");
  });
});

slides.title: Set up Jest for ES modules
slides.html:
Setup

Set up Jest for ES modules

  • Jest needs a flag for import
  • Split app.js from server.js
  • Tests import the app, not the server

Setup

npm i -D jest supertest mongodb-memory-server
 
// package.json
"scripts": {
  "test": "node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js"
}
 
// src/app.js   → builds and exports the Express app
// src/server.js → connects to MongoDB and calls app.listen()

slides.title: A throwaway test database
slides.html:
Database

A throwaway test database

  • Never test against real data
  • mongodb-memory-server runs MongoDB in memory
  • Clear collections between tests

tests/setup.js

import { MongoMemoryServer } from "mongodb-memory-server";
let mongo;
beforeAll(async () => {
  mongo = await MongoMemoryServer.create();
  await mongoose.connect(mongo.getUri());
});
afterEach(async () => {
  for (const c of Object.values(mongoose.connection.collections))
    await c.deleteMany({});
});
afterAll(async () => {
  await mongoose.disconnect(); await mongo.stop();
});

slides.title: Integration tests with Supertest
slides.html:
Supertest

Integration tests with Supertest

  • Sends real HTTP requests to your app
  • No need to start a server
  • Check status and body

tests/posts.test.js

import request from "supertest";
import app from "../src/app.js";
 
test("rejects a post without a title", async () => {
  const agent = await loggedInAgent("author");
 
  const res = await agent.post("/api/posts").send({ body: "x".repeat(30) });
 
  expect(res.status).toBe(400);
  expect(res.body.errors[0].field).toBe("title");
});

slides.title: Testing logged-in requests
slides.html:
Auth

Testing logged-in requests

  • request.agent keeps cookies
  • A helper creates and logs in a user
  • Test 401, 403 and the happy path

tests/helpers.js

export async function loggedInAgent(role = "reader") {
  const agent = request.agent(app);
  const email = `${role}${Date.now()}@test.dev`;
  await User.create({ name: "Test", email, password: "password123", role });
  await agent.post("/api/auth/login")
    .send({ email, password: "password123" }).expect(200);
  return agent;
}
 
test("readers can't create posts", async () => {
  const agent = await loggedInAgent("reader");
  await agent.post("/api/posts").send(validPost).expect(403);
});

slides.title: Documenting with Swagger (OpenAPI)
slides.html:
Docs

Documenting with Swagger (OpenAPI)

  • OpenAPI describes every endpoint
  • Swagger UI makes it clickable
  • Keep the spec next to the code

src/app.js

import swaggerUi from "swagger-ui-express";
import YAML from "yaml";
import fs from "node:fs";
 
const spec = YAML.parse(fs.readFileSync("./openapi.yaml", "utf8"));
app.use("/api/docs", swaggerUi.serve, swaggerUi.setup(spec));
 
// open http://localhost:5000/api/docs

slides.title: An OpenAPI endpoint
slides.html:
OpenAPI

An OpenAPI endpoint

  • Paths, methods, inputs, responses
  • Reusable components for schemas
  • Swagger UI has "Try it out"

openapi.yaml

paths:
  /api/posts:
    get:
      summary: List published posts
      parameters:
        - { in: query, name: page, schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1 } }
        - { in: query, name: tag, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: A page of posts
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/PostPage" }
